toolDescriptions.qq_send_message: Send one text message to the current QQ conversation.
toolDescriptions.qq_send_image: Send one favorite image from the current batch’s candidates.
toolDescriptions.qq_generate_image: Generate and send one image when enabled for the current batch.
toolDescriptions.qq_skip_reply: End an optional group follow-up or icebreaker without replying.

generalFields.titlesEnabled: Improve session titles with the auxiliary model
generalFields.titlesDescription: New conversations use the first 15 characters of your message as their title. The auxiliary model can replace it with a generated title; if unavailable, the original title is kept.
